<template>
	<AsamButton :loading="loading" @click="load" type="primary">读取本地数据</AsamButton>
	<p role="status">{{ message }}</p>
</template>
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createRequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
const message = ref('等待读取');
const loading = ref(false);
let alive = true;
const client = createRequestClient({
	transport: async () => ({ mode: 'data', data: { message: '本地数据已读取' } })
});
async function load() {
	if (loading.value) return;
	loading.value = true;
	try {
		const value = await client.request(
			{ url: '/local-example' },
			{
				decode: (data) => {
					if (
						!data ||
						typeof data !== 'object' ||
						!('message' in data) ||
						typeof data.message !== 'string'
					)
						throw new Error('响应不符合约定');
					return data.message;
				}
			}
		);
		if (alive) message.value = value;
	} catch {
		if (alive) message.value = '读取未完成，请重试';
	} finally {
		if (alive) loading.value = false;
	}
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	client.dispose();
});
</script>

import { onScopeDispose } from 'vue';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { createPreferences } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
/** The example host owns these words and its mock option labels. */
const dictionaries = {
	'zh-CN': {
		title: '请求与错误联动',
		description: '本地模拟请求，认证与错误呈现由应用注入。',
		scenario: '场景',
		success: '正常',
		empty: '空数据',
		business: '业务失败',
		auth: '认证失效',
		network: '网络失败',
		unknown: '未知异常',
		load: '加载 / 恢复',
		rotate: '更新模拟认证',
		mount: '卸载 / 重挂组件',
		revisions: '认证更新次数',
		authTitle: '认证需要更新',
		failedTitle: '请求暂时无法完成',
		recover: '恢复正常请求',
		placeholder: '选择本地测试项目',
		selected: '当前选择',
		none: '未选择',
		feedback: '反馈次数'
	},
	en: {
		title: 'Requests and error feedback',
		description:
			'Local mock requests. The host supplies authentication and error presentation.',
		scenario: 'Scenario',
		success: 'Success',
		empty: 'Empty data',
		business: 'Business failure',
		auth: 'Authentication expired',
		network: 'Network failure',
		unknown: 'Unknown error',
		load: 'Load / recover',
		rotate: 'Update mock authentication',
		mount: 'Unmount / remount control',
		revisions: 'Authentication updates',
		authTitle: 'Authentication needs updating',
		failedTitle: 'The request is temporarily unavailable',
		recover: 'Restore successful requests',
		placeholder: 'Select a local test item',
		selected: 'Current selection',
		none: 'Not selected',
		feedback: 'Feedback count'
	}
};
export function useExampleText(explicit?: AsamI18n) {
	const scope = explicit ?? useAsamProI18n();
	const preferences = createPreferences({
		app: 'transport-example-text',
		owner: [],
		dictionaries,
		fallbackLocale: 'en',
		force: {
			get locale() {
				return scope.locale.value;
			}
		}
	});
	onScopeDispose(preferences.dispose);
	return { t: preferences.t, scope };
}

<template>
	<main>
		<h1>{{ text.t('title') }}</h1>
		<p>{{ text.t('description') }}</p>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<div data-asam-field-caption>{{ text.t('scenario') }}
			<AsamSelect
				v-model="scenario"
				:aria-label="text.t('scenario')"
				@change="updateScenario"
			><AsamOption value="success" :label="text.t('success')"  /><AsamOption value="empty" :label="text.t('empty')"  /><AsamOption value="business" :label="text.t('business')"  /><AsamOption value="auth" :label="text.t('auth')"  /><AsamOption value="network" :label="text.t('network')"  /><AsamOption value="unknown" :label="text.t('unknown')"  /></AsamSelect></div>
		<AsamButton @click="reload" type="primary">{{ text.t('load') }}</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="rotateAuth" type="primary">{{ text.t('rotate') }}</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="mounted = !mounted" type="primary">{{ text.t('mount') }}</AsamButton>
		<p role="status">{{ text.t('revisions') }}{{ authRevision }}</p>
		<section v-if="notice" role="alert">
			<h2>{{ text.t(notice.kind === 'auth' ? 'authTitle' : 'failedTitle') }}</h2>
			<p>{{ notice.message }}（{{ notice.traceId }}）</p>
			<AsamButton @click="recover" type="primary">{{ text.t('recover') }}</AsamButton>
		</section>
		<AsamRemoteSelect
			v-if="mounted"
			ref="remote"
			v-model="value"
			:request="request"
			:placeholder="text.t('placeholder')"
		/>
		<p>
			{{ text.t('selected') }}{{ value ?? text.t('none') }}{{ text.t('feedback')
			}}{{ feedbackCount }}
		</p>
	</main>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
import { AsamButton, AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { inject, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamRemoteSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamAsyncSelectExpose, AsamValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { SafeError } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { Scenario } from './mock.js';
import { demoContextKey } from './context.js';

const context = inject(demoContextKey);
if (!context) throw new Error('Transport demo context missing');
const demo = context;
const text = useExampleText(demo.i18n);

const scenario = ref<Scenario>('success');
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const mounted = ref(true);
const remote = ref<AsamAsyncSelectExpose<AsamValue, object>>();
const notice = ref<SafeError>();
const feedbackCount = ref(0);
const authRevision = ref(0);
const request = { url: '/local-options', method: 'get' as const };
const remove = demo.subscribe((error) => {
	notice.value = error;
	feedbackCount.value++;
});
function updateScenario() {
	demo.setScenario(scenario.value);
}
function reload() {
	void remote.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
function rotateAuth() {
	demo.updateAuth();
	authRevision.value++;
}
function recover() {
	scenario.value = 'success';
	updateScenario();
	notice.value = undefined;
	reload();
}
onUnmounted(remove);
</script>

import { createApp, h } from 'vue';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { AsamConfigProvider, provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import { createRequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createTransportProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { SafeError } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createMockTransport, unwrapMock } from './mock.js';
import TransportDemo from './TransportDemo.vue';
import { demoContextKey } from './context.js';

export function mountDemo(
	element: Element,
	options: { i18n?: AsamI18n } = {},
	onError?: (error: unknown) => void
) {
	const mock = createMockTransport();
	let authVersion = 1;
	const listeners = new Set<(error: SafeError) => void>();
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n: options.i18n,
		transport: mock.transport,
		auth: () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer local-mock-${authVersion}` }),
		present: (error) => {
			for (const listener of listeners) listener(error);
		}
	});
	const app = createApp({
		render: () => h(AsamConfigProvider, { i18n: options.i18n }, () => h(TransportDemo))
	});
	app.provide(demoContextKey, {
		i18n: options.i18n,
		setScenario: mock.setScenario,
		updateAuth() {
			authVersion++;
		},
		subscribe(listener) {
			listeners.add(listener);
			return () => {
				listeners.delete(listener);
			};
		}
	});
	provideAsamData(app, createTransportProvider(client, unwrapMock));
	((app.config.errorHandler = onError), app.mount(element));
	return () => {
		app.unmount();
		client.dispose();
		listeners.clear();
	};
}

import type { InjectionKey } from 'vue';
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import type { SafeError } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { Scenario } from './mock.js';
export interface DemoContext {
	i18n?: AsamI18n;
	setScenario(scenario: Scenario): void;
	updateAuth(): void;
	subscribe(listener: (error: SafeError) => void): () => void;
}
export const demoContextKey: InjectionKey<DemoContext> = Symbol('TransportDemo');
ts
import { TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import type { ClientOptions } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';

export type Scenario = 'success' | 'empty' | 'business' | 'auth' | 'network' | 'unknown';
export function createMockTransport(): {
	transport: ClientOptions['transport'];
	setScenario(scenario: Scenario): void;
} {
	let scenario: Scenario = 'success';
	return {
		setScenario(value) {
			scenario = value;
		},
		async transport(_input, context) {
			const selected = scenario;
			await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, 30);
				context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
			});
			if (selected === 'network') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (selected === 'unknown') throw new Error('mock-secret-token-hidden');
			if (selected === 'auth') return { mode: 'raw', status: 401, body: null };
			if (selected === 'business') throw new TransportFault('business');
			return {
				mode: 'raw',
				status: 200,
				body: {
					data:
						selected === 'empty'
							? []
							: [
									{ label: '测试项目一', value: 'one' },
									{ label: '测试项目二', value: 'two' }
								]
				}
			};
		}
	};
}

export function unwrapMock(body: unknown): unknown {
	if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || !('data' in body))
		throw new TransportFault('business');
	return body.data;
}

import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
import { mountDemo } from './application.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(
	element: Element,
	onError: (error: unknown) => void,
	i18n?: AsamI18n
) {
	const result = await mountDemo(element, { i18n }, onError);
	return result;
}

import { createApp } from 'vue';
import type { App, Component } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import * as entry from './src/inline-entry';
const demo: {
	default: Component;
	scoped?: boolean;
	configure?: (app: App) => void | (() => void) | Promise<void | (() => void)>;
} = entry;
const app = createApp(
	demo.default,
	demo.scoped ? { scopeId: 'application/transport:demo-application-transport' } : undefined
);
const cleanup = await demo.configure?.(app);
if (typeof cleanup === 'function') app.onUnmount(cleanup);
app.mount('#app');
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => app.unmount(), { once: true });

# transport完整示例

使用Node22.19+的22.x及pnpm11.9.0。在解压目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor内正常UI/Pro包与锁文件配套；无源码alias或借入node_modules。

src/MinimalExample.vue展示本能力最小用法；完整场景保留原路由、provider及本地fixture。src/mount.ts与根main.ts已经接好启动和释放，不需要手写网站宿主。预览设置检测不到网站侧栏时在原位置显示。会话、请求均为本地合成，不连接真实业务后端。跨能力通过公开Pro叶子入口引用，导航的Vue Router是必要依赖，其他样式/按钮与fixture属于演示宿主。

Tiptap既有传递依赖可能出现peer告警，未通过修改依赖版本掩盖。

本工程默认运行与文档页内相同的最小示例，入口见src/inline-entry.ts。完整App及作者宿主仍保留在src目录中，可按其依赖单独接入。场景源码ZIP保留同名相对路径，正常包仅位于完整工程vendor目录。
md
# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

<template>
	<AsamButton :loading="loading" @click="load" type="primary">读取本地数据</AsamButton>
	<p role="status">{{ message }}</p>
</template>
<script setup>
import { onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { createRequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
const message = ref('等待读取');
const loading = ref(false);
let alive = true;
const client = createRequestClient({
	transport: async () => ({ mode: 'data', data: { message: '本地数据已读取' } })
});
async function load() {
	if (loading.value) return;
	loading.value = true;
	try {
		const value = await client.request(
			{ url: '/local-example' },
			{
				decode: (data) => {
					if (
						!data ||
						typeof data !== 'object' ||
						!('message' in data) ||
						typeof data.message !== 'string'
					)
						throw new Error('响应不符合约定');
					return data.message;
				}
			}
		);
		if (alive) message.value = value;
	} catch {
		if (alive) message.value = '读取未完成，请重试';
	} finally {
		if (alive) loading.value = false;
	}
}
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
	alive = false;
	client.dispose();
});
</script>

import { onScopeDispose } from 'vue';
import { useAsamProI18n } from '@asam-ui/pro/i18n';
import { createPreferences } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/preferences';
/** The example host owns these words and its mock option labels. */
const dictionaries = {
	'zh-CN': {
		title: '请求与错误联动',
		description: '本地模拟请求，认证与错误呈现由应用注入。',
		scenario: '场景',
		success: '正常',
		empty: '空数据',
		business: '业务失败',
		auth: '认证失效',
		network: '网络失败',
		unknown: '未知异常',
		load: '加载 / 恢复',
		rotate: '更新模拟认证',
		mount: '卸载 / 重挂组件',
		revisions: '认证更新次数',
		authTitle: '认证需要更新',
		failedTitle: '请求暂时无法完成',
		recover: '恢复正常请求',
		placeholder: '选择本地测试项目',
		selected: '当前选择',
		none: '未选择',
		feedback: '反馈次数'
	},
	en: {
		title: 'Requests and error feedback',
		description:
			'Local mock requests. The host supplies authentication and error presentation.',
		scenario: 'Scenario',
		success: 'Success',
		empty: 'Empty data',
		business: 'Business failure',
		auth: 'Authentication expired',
		network: 'Network failure',
		unknown: 'Unknown error',
		load: 'Load / recover',
		rotate: 'Update mock authentication',
		mount: 'Unmount / remount control',
		revisions: 'Authentication updates',
		authTitle: 'Authentication needs updating',
		failedTitle: 'The request is temporarily unavailable',
		recover: 'Restore successful requests',
		placeholder: 'Select a local test item',
		selected: 'Current selection',
		none: 'Not selected',
		feedback: 'Feedback count'
	}
};
export function useExampleText(explicit) {
	const scope = explicit ?? useAsamProI18n();
	const preferences = createPreferences({
		app: 'transport-example-text',
		owner: [],
		dictionaries,
		fallbackLocale: 'en',
		force: {
			get locale() {
				return scope.locale.value;
			}
		}
	});
	onScopeDispose(preferences.dispose);
	return { t: preferences.t, scope };
}

<template>
	<main>
		<h1>{{ text.t('title') }}</h1>
		<p>{{ text.t('description') }}</p>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<div data-asam-field-caption>{{ text.t('scenario') }}
			<AsamSelect
				v-model="scenario"
				:aria-label="text.t('scenario')"
				@change="updateScenario"
			><AsamOption value="success" :label="text.t('success')"  /><AsamOption value="empty" :label="text.t('empty')"  /><AsamOption value="business" :label="text.t('business')"  /><AsamOption value="auth" :label="text.t('auth')"  /><AsamOption value="network" :label="text.t('network')"  /><AsamOption value="unknown" :label="text.t('unknown')"  /></AsamSelect></div>
		<AsamButton @click="reload" type="primary">{{ text.t('load') }}</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="rotateAuth" type="primary">{{ text.t('rotate') }}</AsamButton
		><AsamButton @click="mounted = !mounted" type="primary">{{ text.t('mount') }}</AsamButton>
		<p role="status">{{ text.t('revisions') }}{{ authRevision }}</p>
		<section v-if="notice" role="alert">
			<h2>{{ text.t(notice.kind === 'auth' ? 'authTitle' : 'failedTitle') }}</h2>
			<p>{{ notice.message }}（{{ notice.traceId }}）</p>
			<AsamButton @click="recover" type="primary">{{ text.t('recover') }}</AsamButton>
		</section>
		<AsamRemoteSelect
			v-if="mounted"
			ref="remote"
			v-model="value"
			:request="request"
			:placeholder="text.t('placeholder')"
		/>
		<p>
			{{ text.t('selected') }}{{ value ?? text.t('none') }}{{ text.t('feedback')
			}}{{ feedbackCount }}
		</p>
	</main>
</template>

<script setup>
import { useExampleText } from './Texts.js';
import { AsamButton, AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { inject, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamRemoteSelect } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { demoContextKey } from './context.js';
const context = inject(demoContextKey);
if (!context) throw new Error('Transport demo context missing');
const demo = context;
const text = useExampleText(demo.i18n);
const scenario = ref('success');
const value = ref(null);
const mounted = ref(true);
const remote = ref();
const notice = ref();
const feedbackCount = ref(0);
const authRevision = ref(0);
const request = { url: '/local-options', method: 'get' };
const remove = demo.subscribe((error) => {
	notice.value = error;
	feedbackCount.value++;
});
function updateScenario() {
	demo.setScenario(scenario.value);
}
function reload() {
	void remote.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
function rotateAuth() {
	demo.updateAuth();
	authRevision.value++;
}
function recover() {
	scenario.value = 'success';
	updateScenario();
	notice.value = undefined;
	reload();
}
onUnmounted(remove);
</script>

import { createApp, h } from 'vue';
import { AsamConfigProvider, provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import { createRequestClient } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createTransportProvider } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { createMockTransport, unwrapMock } from './mock.js';
import TransportDemo from './TransportDemo.vue';
import { demoContextKey } from './context.js';
export function mountDemo(element, options = {}, onError) {
	const mock = createMockTransport();
	let authVersion = 1;
	const listeners = new Set();
	const client = createRequestClient({
		i18n: options.i18n,
		transport: mock.transport,
		auth: () => ({ Authorization: `Bearer local-mock-${authVersion}` }),
		present: (error) => {
			for (const listener of listeners) listener(error);
		}
	});
	const app = createApp({
		render: () => h(AsamConfigProvider, { i18n: options.i18n }, () => h(TransportDemo))
	});
	app.provide(demoContextKey, {
		i18n: options.i18n,
		setScenario: mock.setScenario,
		updateAuth() {
			authVersion++;
		},
		subscribe(listener) {
			listeners.add(listener);
			return () => {
				listeners.delete(listener);
			};
		}
	});
	provideAsamData(app, createTransportProvider(client, unwrapMock));
	((app.config.errorHandler = onError), app.mount(element));
	return () => {
		app.unmount();
		client.dispose();
		listeners.clear();
	};
}
js
export const demoContextKey = Symbol('TransportDemo');
js
import { TransportFault } from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
export function createMockTransport() {
	let scenario = 'success';
	return {
		setScenario(value) {
			scenario = value;
		},
		async transport(_input, context) {
			const selected = scenario;
			await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
				const abort = () => {
					clearTimeout(timer);
					reject(new TransportFault('cancelled'));
				};
				const timer = setTimeout(() => {
					context.signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					resolve();
				}, 30);
				context.signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (context.signal.aborted) abort();
			});
			if (selected === 'network') throw new TransportFault('network');
			if (selected === 'unknown') throw new Error('mock-secret-token-hidden');
			if (selected === 'auth') return { mode: 'raw', status: 401, body: null };
			if (selected === 'business') throw new TransportFault('business');
			return {
				mode: 'raw',
				status: 200,
				body: {
					data:
						selected === 'empty'
							? []
							: [
									{ label: '测试项目一', value: 'one' },
									{ label: '测试项目二', value: 'two' }
								]
				}
			};
		}
	};
}
export function unwrapMock(body) {
	if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || !('data' in body))
		throw new TransportFault('business');
	return body.data;
}

import { mountDemo } from './application.js';
export async function mountWebsiteExample(element, onError, i18n) {
	const result = await mountDemo(element, { i18n }, onError);
	return result;
}

js
import { createApp } from 'vue';
import 'element-plus/dist/index.css';
import '@asam-ui/ui/style.css';
import '@asam-ui/pro/style.css';
import * as entry from './src/inline-entry';
const demo = entry;
const app = createApp(
	demo.default,
	demo.scoped ? { scopeId: 'application/transport:demo-application-transport' } : undefined
);
const cleanup = await demo.configure?.(app);
if (typeof cleanup === 'function') app.onUnmount(cleanup);
app.mount('#app');
window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => app.unmount(), { once: true });

md
# transport完整示例

使用Node22.19+的22.x及pnpm11.9.0。在解压目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor内正常UI/Pro包与锁文件配套；无源码alias或借入node_modules。

src/MinimalExample.vue展示本能力最小用法；完整场景保留原路由、provider及本地fixture。src/mount.ts与根main.ts已经接好启动和释放，不需要手写网站宿主。预览设置检测不到网站侧栏时在原位置显示。会话、请求均为本地合成，不连接真实业务后端。跨能力通过公开Pro叶子入口引用，导航的Vue Router是必要依赖，其他样式/按钮与fixture属于演示宿主。

Tiptap既有传递依赖可能出现peer告警，未通过修改依赖版本掩盖。

本工程默认运行与文档页内相同的最小示例，入口见src/inline-entry.js。完整App及作者宿主仍保留在src目录中，可按其依赖单独接入。场景源码ZIP保留同名相对路径，正常包仅位于完整工程vendor目录。
md
# 第三方能力来源

Pro 应用组合式能力通过正式依赖 `@vant/use@1.6.0` 的公开入口复用实现，不依赖 Vant UI 或其样式。

上游：[Vant Use](https://github.com/youzan/vant/tree/main/packages/vant-use)。许可证：MIT。版权：Youzan、Chen Jiahan and other contributors。上游包自身包含其发布声明；安装后的第三方代码仍受其许可证约束。

ASAM 增量为分类/能力出口、自动导入映射、示例及 `AsamCustomField` 表单桥接。`flattenVNodes`、`sortChildren`、`supportsPassive` 不属于 Pro 公开 API，不提供自动导入。上游内部使用自己的辅助函数不构成 ASAM 新增出口。

`useEventListener` 在非浏览器时补齐可调用的停止函数；`useChildren` 在父组件更新时调用上游现有排序函数，同步已关联实例的索引。这两处是薄适配，不复制或改写上游监听/排序算法。父子关联使用上游同样的 Vue 实例协议，按项目锁定的 Vue 版本验证。

	"schemaVersion": 1,
	"ability": "transport",
	"entry": "main.js",

完整可运行工程

源码面板保留最小用法、作者完整示例和工程配置；完整工程 ZIP 另含正常包 vendor、锁文件与所需补丁。解压后运行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck和pnpm run dev，默认运行同一份页内示例。完整独立预览展示组合应用。示例使用本地合成数据，真实会话、菜单与业务传输由消费应用注入。

继续接入

快速开始 · 版本与迁移

接口、行为与迁移细节

使用说明

从@asam-ui/pro/application/transport导入createRequestClient, createLatestRequest, createTransportProvider；主包Application.transport共享同一实现。类型使用同路径import type。宿主注入HTTP供应商、认证、一次解包、数据校验与反馈。没有默认fetch/Axios、自动重试或真实业务后端；dispose取消本实例活跃请求。 最小与完整示例、逐文件复制下载及完整工程ZIP见本页示例区。

从 index.ts 导入 createRequestClient、createTransportProvider、createLatestRequest 与公开 Types。应用负责认证、HTTP 供应商、业务解包、数据校验、反馈及导航；packages/ui/src/data/types.ts / packages/yudao/src/index.ts 是既有协议依据。禁止把本模块反向导入 UI runtime。

接入应用

从公开叶子入口导入，并正常安装配套ASAM包。页面示例提供真实 provider、远程选择器与本地模拟服务。

打开本地工程输出的页面地址。完整 SFC examples/TransportDemo.vue 使用真实 AsamRemoteSelect 和 provider；选择业务失败后加载，看到一条反馈和错误容器，再恢复并打开下拉可看到两条本地选项。修改 mock.ts 可验证空、认证、网络及未知错误；token 仅为模拟值且不进入 DOM。

公共 API 与默认值

API / 选项 默认与覆盖 边界
transport(input, context) 必填应用注入 返回 raw 或 data 判别联合；无隐式 fetch / Axios / 重试
auth(signal) 无认证；每次读取，可异步 必须响应 signal，更新认证不改实例；headers 仅交供应商
online() 未配置则尝试传输 不访问 navigator，应用可注入离线状态
timeoutMs 15000ms；每次可覆盖；0 禁用 有限非负，最大 2147483647；涵盖认证、transport、异步解包
request(input, { decode, unwrap, signal }) decode 必填；无自动解包 raw 成功状态仅 unwrap 一次；data 直接 decode；decode 同步校验/映射
present(error) 默认无反馈 安全分类、固定文案、内部编号；每个错误最多调用一次，不等待 callback 完成
log(event) 默认无日志 仅 traceId/outcome/durationMs；不传 URL/headers/params/body/异常/服务端消息
dispose() 终止所有活跃请求 幂等；之后请求取消，不重新激活，重挂须创建新实例
createLatestRequest(client, commit) 一个消费容器一个实例 新 load 取消旧 load，只有当前结果 commit；cancel/dispose 不呈现取消反馈
createTransportProvider(client, unwrap) 复用 ASAM 数据协议 provider 输出业务 data，组件 transform 只做选项/分页映射

TransportResponse 的 mode:'raw' 指 HTTP status/body；mode:'data' 指供应商已解包的业务值，即使有名为 data 的属性也不会再次解包。raw 401/403 归 auth，其他非 2xx 归 business。供应商以 TransportFault('network') 报网络故障；无法可靠识别的抛出归 unknown，避免把所有 TypeError 猜为网络。取消原因和原始异常被丢弃，RequestFailure 不含 cause。服务端追踪字段默认不采纳；本实例 request-N 为本地顺序编号，应用应以实例日志容器区分多个实例。

应用使用配方

ts
import {
	createRequestClient,
	createTransportProvider,
	TransportFault
} from '@asam-ui/pro/application/transport';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const client = createRequestClient({
	transport: applicationTransport,
	auth: applicationAuthentication,
	present: (error) => applicationErrorContainer.show(error),
	log: (event) => localSafeDiagnostics.append(event)
});
provideAsamData(
	app,
	createTransportProvider(client, (body) => {
		if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || !('data' in body))
			throw new TransportFault('business');
		return body.data;
	})
);
// applicationTransport / Authentication / ErrorContainer 是应用实现的注入点。
// 真实的可执行实现见 examples/application.ts 与 mock.ts。

一次错误 callback 中由应用决定显示 toast、错误页或导航；模板不直接操作路由。组件使用 isErrorNotified 和 onError 去重；组件自己的 transform 失败仅产生固定 unknown 提示。不要把不可信错误消息直接渲染或调用 console.error(cause)。应用注入的 transport/auth/decoder 自身仍须避免记录秘密，本模块不可能约束宿主自行外传。

认证变更后应用若有组件缓存，应按现有 setAsamDataScope / invalidateAsamData 协议切 scope 或清缓存；请求层不代管登录态或字典缓存。示例更新模拟认证后用强制 reload 重新请求。

使用步骤

确认供应商返回 raw 或 data，注入认证与安全反馈，将 provider 接到组件；transform 仅负责选项/分页映射，不再次解包。独立容器创建自己的 latest，卸载时取消。账号、业务 URL 和登录导航由应用实现。

迁移

既有 UI/provider/Yudao API 无破坏修改。应用原本在 Axios 解包的，应返回 mode:'data'；尚未解包的返回 raw 并注入 unwrap。避免同时启用 Yudao 的解包适配器，否则会再次解包，应在应用选择单一责任层。本模板 provider 输出已解包数据；选项与分页组件继续现有格式映射。旧 toast 与模板 present 二选其一，模板接管时移除原 transport 的 toast。旧无界 retry 移除，用户显式再次请求；不内建任何自动重试，尤其 POST/PUT/DELETE。

验证与适用范围

请求核心可以用于没有 window / navigator 的 Node 环境；本页 SFC 是客户端示例，完整 SSR hydration 需应用验证。示例使用本地模拟服务，不承诺真实后台权限、账号或服务耗时。

组件外消息与语言迁移

createRequestClient({ transport, i18n, ... }) 读取显式应用作用域；它不依赖组件 setup，也不创建全局语言单例。组件 Provider 与客户端应接收同一 i18n，SSR 每个请求单独创建和释放。未传 i18n 的旧项目保留历史行为。

present 接收本能力约定的安全反馈。展示已生成的本能力错误时用 i18n.formatError(error) 读取当前语言，保留原始错误对象、诊断码、traceId 和 message；不把服务端原始文本或任意 Error.message 识别成资源 key。语言变化不重发请求、不重新解包，也不改变原有取消和结果提交语义。

更多组件外消息、业务字典边界及独立工程见语言与区域。

完整类型

Types.ts · 完整类型
ts
import type { AsamI18n } from '@asam-ui/ui/i18n';
export type ErrorKind =
	'cancelled' | 'timeout' | 'offline' | 'network' | 'auth' | 'business' | 'unknown';

/** HTTP 包装与已适配业务值必须显式区别，绝不根据 data 属性猜形状。 */
export type TransportResponse =
	| { readonly mode: 'raw'; readonly status: number; readonly body: unknown }
	| { readonly mode: 'data'; readonly data: unknown };

export interface RequestInput {
	readonly url: string;
	readonly method?: 'get' | 'post' | 'put' | 'delete';
	readonly params?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
	readonly data?: unknown;
}

export interface TransportContext {
	readonly signal: AbortSignal;
	readonly headers: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
	/** 本实例生成的非业务编号；不采用服务端可能含秘密的追踪字段。 */
	readonly traceId: string;
}

export interface SafeError {
	readonly kind: ErrorKind;
	readonly message: string;
	readonly traceId: string;
}

/** 固定白名单日志。不提供 URL、headers、body、token、原始异常或业务消息。 */
export interface RequestLog {
	readonly traceId: string;
	readonly outcome: 'success' | ErrorKind;
	readonly durationMs: number;
}

export interface ClientOptions {
	/** Explicit language owner for safe feedback; transport diagnostics remain unchanged. */
	readonly i18n?: AsamI18n;
	readonly transport: (
		input: RequestInput,
		context: TransportContext
	) => Promise<TransportResponse>;
	/** 每次请求读取最新认证；异步认证也受取消和超时保护。 */
	readonly auth?: (
		signal: AbortSignal
	) => Readonly<Record<string, string>> | Promise<Readonly<Record<string, string>>>;
	readonly online?: () => boolean;
	/** 一个 callback 中由应用决定反馈、错误页或导航；不会自动重试。 */
	readonly present?: (error: SafeError) => void | Promise<void>;
	readonly log?: (event: RequestLog) => void | Promise<void>;
	readonly timeoutMs?: number;
}

export interface RequestOptions<T> {
	readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
	readonly timeoutMs?: number;
	/** 仅 raw 的 body 调用一次；data 分支要求供应商已经适配。两分支均经 decode 校验。 */
	readonly unwrap?: (body: unknown) => unknown | Promise<unknown>;
	readonly decode: (data: unknown) => T;
}

export interface RequestClient {
	request<T>(input: RequestInput, options: RequestOptions<T>): Promise<T>;
	isErrorNotified(error: unknown): boolean;
	/** 未经本 client 呈现的组件错误，仅以安全的 unknown 分类呈现。 */
	presentComponentError(error: unknown): void;
	dispose(): void;
}
